verdict.rationale: Yapily is a data-processing SaaS that handles customers' financial data, so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data is excluded from AI model training. The axis applies, but the evidence pack contains no documented AI-training opt-out or no-training commitment. The open-banking consent flows control bank account access, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
